stories.title: SHEIN Recalls Pull & Chew Montessori Teething Toys — Choking Hazard

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
RECALL: SHEIN Pull & Chew Montessori Teething Toys. Silicone strings can reach back of a child's throat — choking/respiratory hazard.

Stop use. Cut strings. Email productrecall@shein.com for refund. 🚨

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
If you bought SHEIN's Pull & Chew Montessori Teething Toy from SHEIN.com between Dec 2025 and Apr 2026, stop using it now. CPSC recall — choking hazard.

Cut strings, then email productrecall@shein.com with a photo.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: SHEIN Recalls Pull & Chew Montessori Teething Toys — CPSC Cites Choking and Respiratory Hazard

stories.title: 6.7 Million Kids Live in Homes with Loaded, Unlocked Guns — New Research

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
6.7 million children in the US live in homes with a loaded, unlocked gun — per AAP's Pediatrics journal.

Safe storage saves lives: unloaded firearm, locked safe, ammo stored separately. Talk to your pediatrician.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
If you own a firearm and have kids at home: BeSmartForKids.org and ProjectChildSafe.org have free safe storage resources.

New AAP data: 6.7M children live in homes with loaded, unlocked guns. This is preventable.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: 6.7 Million Kids Live in Homes with Loaded, Unlocked Guns — What Colorado Springs Parents Need to Know
